nodes.description: Owned.owner: privileged account address, set to msg.sender at construction and changed by acceptOwnership.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address set by transferOwnership and cleared by acceptOwnership.
CareKoreaToken.symbol = 'KACW'.
CareKoreaToken.name = 'Care Korea Token'.
CareKoreaToken.decimals = 8.
Total token supply, 1000000 * 10**decimals, assigned to balances[owner] in constructor.
mapping(address => uint) of token balances; mutated in transfer and transferFrom.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowance table; mutated in approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance debits and allowance writes.
onlyOwner function that sets newOwner, starting the ownership handover.
Transfers ownership if msg.sender equals newOwner, then resets newOwner to address(0).
Debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[to]; emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens; emits Approval.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decrements the caller allowance; emits Transfer.
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then performs an external receiveApproval callback on the spender contract.
onlyOwner function calling transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 token address with owner as recipient.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) with attacker-controlled spender and data.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary, owner-supplied token contract.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Initializes metadata, total supply, mints all tokens to owner and emits Transfer.
Payable fallback that always reverts, rejecting plain ether transfers.

edges.reason: Parameter _newOwner is written into newOwner by transferOwnership.
transfer credits the recipient address parameter in balances.
transfer uses the tokens parameter as the debited/credited amount.
approve uses spender as the allowance key.

transferFrom credits balances of the 'to' parameter.
transferFrom uses tokens as the moved amount.

allowance uses spender as the second mapping key.
approveAndCall stores allowance for spender and calls it back.
approveAndCall stores and forwards the tokens amount.
approveAndCall forwards caller-supplied data to the callback.
transferAnyERC20Token casts tokenAddress into ERC20Interface.
transferAnyERC20Token forwards tokens to the external transfer call.

onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before allowing the handover.
acceptOwnership authorizes the caller with require(msg.sender == newOwner).
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] of the caller.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].

acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).

approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom rewrites balances for from and to.
transferFrom decreases the allowed allowance mapping.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.

transfer performs balances[msg.sender].sub(tokens), an arithmetic site.
transfer performs balances[to].add(tokens), an arithmetic site.

The balance subtraction is delegated to SafeMath.sub.
The balance addition is delegated to SafeMath.add.
The transferFrom subtraction is delegated to SafeMath.sub.
The transferFrom addition is delegated to SafeMath.add.
The totalSupply subtraction is delegated to SafeMath.sub.
approveAndCall invokes the untrusted spender contract's receiveApproval callback.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes transfer on an arbitrary token contract supplied by the owner.
The receiveApproval callback executes while the allowed state from approveAndCall is already committed, allowing re-entrant allowance manipulation.
The untrusted callback can re-enter transfer before approveAndCall returns.
The arbitrary external token contract invoked from transferAnyERC20Token can re-enter and mutate token balances.
